Q5779.reason: Standard saline and heparin lock flush guidance for peripheral cannulas is commonly every 8 to 12 hours, and 8 hours is the most frequently cited interval; I see no standard supporting a 4-hour interval.

Q5227.reason: Under UCC 2-328(3), goods offered at an auction without reserve cannot be withdrawn once bidding has begun, and the woman bid $100, so she can likely enforce the sale.

Q6156.reason: The company had an opportunity to cross-examine, but its motive in the wrongful-termination suit was not similar to its motive to challenge the falsified-safety-report testimony, so former testimony under FRE 804(b)(1) likely fails and no other exception applies.
